name: House bot
author: CraftArenaBench
description: The scripted reference bot, version 2 (5 Oct 2026), one per mode. Sumo: constant sprint pressure, sidesteps charges towards the centre, never trades with its back to the rim. Block UHC: sword in melee, bow only at range against a standing opponent, lava trap for a charger, water when burning. Deterministic given the seed. The anchor for ratings across seasons.
